page.overview:
Who is Graeae?

The Graeae ("Gray Ones") are three Titan sisters in Ancient Greek mythology. They are hags or witches in Greek mythology. They were described as sharing only one eye, one tooth and one tongue, having to share use of these three grisly detachable body parts to communicate or take action.

In the Marvel fictional universe it is mentioned they are the offspring of Echidna but they have not yet made an appearance in Marvel Comics.

In the Marvel fictional universe, the Graeae are granddaughters of the Elder God Set, as the offspring of Set's son Phorcys who mated with Ceto, a sea monster. The sisters are witches that look like ancient women (hags) and they share one eye and one tooth. Whose names are Enyo, Deino (or Dino), and Pemphredo (or Pephredo).

They have also been called the Grey Ones of Hellas and were individually known as Pephredo, Enyo and Deino. In this version they are an avatar of Our Ladies of Sorrow. (: Our Ladies of Sorrow) They were the oracle of men, but that role was then taken over by the keeper of secrets. They tried to retake that role through their daughter, clashing against the Harlot. (: Hexed: The Harlot and the Thief)
